verdict_reason: The new repository-level IT is correct and passes, but it guards only the safest of the five org-scoped methods and leaves the org lead and ACTIVE clause of two hand-written @Query search variants unexercised anywhere in the suite.

todos.issue: The only repository-level IT guards findByIdAndOrganisationId (a Spring Data derived query, so its org predicate is generated); the two hand-written @Query variants whose org lead is a compiler-invisible string literal — searchByCountryCode and searchByQueryAndCountryCode — are never exercised with cross-org data anywhere, so deleting "'organisationId': ?0" from either query string leaves the whole suite green while every organisation's addresses leak.
todos.fix: Add repository-level tests here (or cross-org fixtures to AddressSearchIT) that seed an OTHER_ORG ACTIVE address and assert searchByCountryCode(ORG_A, "GB", page) and searchByQueryAndCountryCode(ORG_A, regex, "GB", page) return only ORG_A rows.

todos.issue: The "'status': 'ACTIVE'" clause in the same two @Query variants is also unguarded: AddressSearchIT.searchIsOrgScopedAndExcludesSoftDeleted only seeds a DELETED row for the q-only path (searchByQuery), and OperatorListIT.listExcludesDeletedTombstones only covers the derived findByOrganisationIdAndStatus, so a countryCode-only or q+countryCode search could return soft-deleted tombstones with no test failing.
todos.fix: In the same new repository-level tests, seed a DELETED address matching the country code and assert searchByCountryCode and searchByQueryAndCountryCode exclude it.

todos.issue: Both tests hold exactly one document, so neither can fail on the defect the class claims to prove: if the id half of the composite predicate were dropped (org-only match), test 1 still returns the single ORG-A row and test 2 still returns empty for ORG-B, and both pass.
todos.fix: Seed a second ORG-A address plus an ORG-B address before each assertion, so the positive test proves the returned id is the one requested and the negative test proves ORG-B's own row is not substituted.
